resolvedQuestions.text: P1: What exact typed, locally repairable IterationResult contract preserves replay while separating type validity, semantic acceptance, and authorization?
How does every proposed loop/harness mechanism remain subordinate to the 036 authority plane?
P2: Which merge, abstract, associate, decay, and forget operations improve memory without erasing contradiction, provenance, replay, negative knowledge, or authority evidence?
P3: What minimal read-only model-callable context/event capability facade should complement the deterministic prompt pack?
P4: Which programmable tactics fit inside a fixed LEAF action set, and which operations must remain workflow-owned?
P5: How should return-shape, evidence/trajectory, and transition-authorization evaluation layers compose, and which mutants prove their independence?
P6: What typed artifact-handle, bounded-preview, and digest-binding rules provide pass-by-reference analogues without unsafe live-object semantics?
P7: What evaluation corpus and mutant matrix will expose stale recall, reflection blur, runaway loops, context pollution, and adjacent harness failures?
How do the paper and all twelve blogs confirm, refine, extend, or contradict studies 1–4 and the live convergence, LEAF, prompt-pack, JSONL, fanout, and loop-lock contracts?
Which design decisions should system-deep-loop adopt, defer, or reject, and what are their explicit when-not-to-use boundaries?

keyFindings.text: **[OBSERVED-IN-PAPER][CONFIRM studies; EXTEND runtime]** NOOA explicitly combines typed input/output, live-object references, code as action, programmable loops, explicit object state, and model-callable context/event APIs. This confirms the studies' typed-boundary direction but extends the current prompt-only harness surface. [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/037-graph-engineering/context/research-paper/NVIDIA-labs-OO-Agents.md:16-20] [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/037-graph-engineering/005-noaa-paper-and-blog-theory/orientation.md:26-35]
sources: Paper, orientation, studies 1–4, and live deep-research contract, cited above.

keyFindings.text: **[OBSERVED-IN-PAPER][REFINE studies; REFINE runtime]** The paper's loop is a method-local call/render/act/update/validate cycle; it is not a sealed multi-agent graph or transition authority. It can refine iteration internals without replacing studies 1–4. [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/037-graph-engineering/context/research-paper/NVIDIA-labs-OO-Agents.md:108-130]
sources: Paper, orientation, studies 1–4, and live deep-research contract, cited above.

keyFindings.text: **[TEXT-CLAIMED][ORTHOGONAL studies; no acceptance effect on runtime]** The paper reports 97.9% over 4,400 interface-capability trials and lower performance on a harder stress subset. These are author-reported measurements, not evidence that this repository's harness meets its own invariants. [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/037-graph-engineering/context/research-paper/NVIDIA-labs-OO-Agents.md:243-283] [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/037-graph-engineering/005-noaa-paper-and-blog-theory/orientation.md:39-39]
sources: Paper, orientation, studies 1–4, and live deep-research contract, cited above.

keyFindings.text: **[CONFIRM studies; CONFIRM runtime]** Studies 1–4 already settle graph proposal, belief, evidence, admission, replay, and 036 authority boundaries. The remaining legitimate subject is how one bounded iteration obtains context, repairs malformed returns, retains useful continuity, and exposes evidence to outer gates. [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/037-graph-engineering/001-agent-swarms/research/research.md:3-21] [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/037-graph-engineering/003-graph-arch/research/research.md:16-20] [INFERENCE: subtracting settled graph/authority decisions from the paper's method-local features]
sources: Paper, orientation, studies 1–4, and live deep-research contract, cited above.

keyFindings.text: **[CONTRADICT wholesale adoption; CONFIRM runtime containment]** NOOA permits in-process state mutation and model-authored subagent calls, whereas the live runtime uses LEAF dispatch, externalized state, fanout isolation, and a lock. Only bounded tactics and read capabilities are candidates here. [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/037-graph-engineering/context/research-paper/NVIDIA-labs-OO-Agents.md:189-203] [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/037-graph-engineering/005-noaa-paper-and-blog-theory/orientation.md:69-75]
